msg: Hello fellow participant! I hope you enjoy the game :) Basically, the gnomes are in eight colours, split into two teams. The yellow basket team and the red basket team. The Yellow, orange, blue & green hatted gnomes belong to the yellow basket. If you choose one of those four colours, you will be presented with a yellow basket on the next screen. The red basket team are Red, pink, purple and brown hatted gnomes. Now, I had previously been advised by another previous participant that the yellow basket team tended to yield the best results. However, on several occasions I chose from the yellow basket team, and found zero mushrooms. The most mushrooms I found were 45, but the majority tended to average around 9 - 15 mushrooms. Whether the red basket team would have yielded higher results is a matter of conjecture. I did from time to time try the gnomes on the red basket team; those results appeared in my view to be just as random. Basically, I kept mainly to the advice I had received from a previous participant, but the resulting mushroom hunts produced varying amounts of mushrooms and it's impossible to tell whether or not the red basket team would have produced very different scores. I suspect not. The game felt fairly random. You go ahead and experiment & see what your results are, it's still a fun game!
